about: Bus routes of the ATI and of the municipal systems of the San Juan metro area and eastern Puerto Rico, compared on the weekday timetables (typical Wednesday): service, route, peak-hour intersections, connections and nearby residents. The flow that makes an intersection high-volume is an estimated design-hour volume (FHWA HPMS 2024 AADT x K factor: the 30th-busiest hour of the year, not a typical weekday peak). Built by docs/analysis/route-analysis-2026-10/ (route_compare.py, make_page.py); fields in the data dictionary (route_compare.*).
